Title: Nikhil's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Nikhil - 10 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Neeta - 38 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Nitin - 40 years, father
Look: glasses, brown sweater

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Nikhil stands in the courtyard. Neeta stands near him.]

Nikhil: "Mom, what's the plan today?"

[Nikhil thinks for a moment.]

Neeta: "Well done!"

[Nikhil gives Mother a flower.]

Nikhil: "Mom, are you okay?"

[Nikhil trips on the step and scrapes his knee; it bleeds.]

Nikhil (laughing): "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
